QUOTE: Under the shipped config, `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC` is off (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:4124`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY gates the macros in platform.h, but it never says it is commented out in the shipped mbedtls_config.h. The "shipped config" claim it makes is about MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC, which is a different symbol.
